protocol.name: local-ruler-13-v2
adaptations: Pinned upstream task-construction functions with deterministic per-case seeds and binary sizing of complete examples.
Four cases/task/length, not a full published RULER run. QA indices shared across lengths; other length controls need not share identical golds.
Essay distractors repeated if needed at 1M. CWE vocabulary cap retained; undersized examples explicitly excluded from near-window macro summaries.
No silent truncation, retry-based answer selection or kernel/precision changes.
NVIDIA low-effort template; explicitly closed think prefix and unchanged assistant answer prefix. The wrapper adds a few tokens to the original roughly-4K margin.
protocol.construction: All v1 task bodies, golds, seeds and selected questions preserved. Only render low-effort header and explicitly close think prefix, then retokenize; no task selection or inference outputs read.

scope: Corrected wrapper; v1 is input provenance only and invalid for intended thinking-off scoring. All cases preserved; no inference outputs used to select or alter examples.
